business: Northstar, a self-hosted job-search and application workspace for Indian college students
by_segment: Pre-final-year student seeking a technical internship
Final-year student preparing for campus placement
why_not: I already check my placement cell, college groups, and LinkedIn, and I mainly need relevant openings rather than another workspace to manage. Having to provide hosting and search or AI credentials sounds like setup work I would avoid during the semester.

I already check placement and internship links on my phone, and setting up hosting plus provider keys sounds like a project of its own. I would skip it unless it worked easily on mobile without setup.

I would keep checking the internship posts on the platforms I already use because this does not tell me which sources are covered or whether the listings are current and legitimate. I also do not want to configure hosting and provider keys just to try it.

I already see openings in several places, and this does not tell me whether the listings are current, paid, or legitimate. I would rather follow the original post directly than set up another tool with hosting and credentials.

As an early-year student, I am only exploring and can keep checking my placement group and the job sites I already know. The offer does not show whether it has the campus and off-campus opportunities I need, and setting up hosting and credentials feels like too much work for now.
